templates.name: openai
templates.description: OpenAI API — GPT-5, GPT-4o, o-series reasoning, and embedding models.

templates.name: google-gemini
templates.description: Google Gemini API — Gemini 2.5 and embedding models.

templates.name: azure-openai
templates.description: Azure OpenAI Service — enterprise-hosted OpenAI models with data residency and compliance.

templates.name: deepseek
templates.description: DeepSeek API — V4 chat and reasoning models.

templates.name: minimax
templates.description: MiniMax API — OpenAI-compatible MoE chat models.

templates.name: glm
templates.description: Zhipu AI API — GLM-4.x and GLM-5 series models.

templates.name: groq
templates.description: Groq high-speed inference — OpenAI-compatible API serving Llama and other open-weight models.

templates.name: together
templates.description: Together AI serverless — OpenAI-compatible API serving open-weight models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, DeepSeek). Model list per 2026-04 vendor docs; admin should verify against https://docs.together.ai/docs/serverless-models before customer-facing use.

templates.name: perplexity
templates.description: Perplexity Sonar API — search-grounded chat with Chain-of-Thought reasoning options. OpenAI-compatible wire format.

templates.name: fireworks
templates.description: Fireworks AI serverless inference — OpenAI-compatible API serving open-weight models with optimized inference profiles. Model list per 2026-04 training data; admin must verify against https://fireworks.ai/models before customer-facing use (this provider's catalog rotates frequently).

templates.name: mistral
templates.description: Mistral La Plateforme — OpenAI-compatible API serving Mistral's flagship + specialist models.

templates.name: cohere
templates.description: Cohere Chat v2 — Command A/R family with native tool use, RAG citations, and multilingual support.

templates.name: huggingface
templates.description: Hugging Face TGI — OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Hugging Face's serverless inference (api-inference.huggingface.co). Model availability and pricing depend on the active provider partnership; admin should verify against https://huggingface.co/docs/api-inference/index before customer-facing use.

templates.name: replicate
templates.description: Replicate predictions API — open-weight LLMs hosted as versioned models. Each model is identified as `owner/name:version`; the Replicate codec wraps OpenAI-canonical chat into the prediction `{version, input}` envelope. Model list per 2026-04 vendor docs; admin should pin specific versions and verify availability against https://replicate.com/explore before customer-facing use.

templates.name: bedrock
templates.description: AWS Bedrock — multi-model envelope serving Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, Mistral, Cohere Command, and Amazon Titan models. Region-specific host (bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com) and SigV4 auth. Model availability varies by region; admin should verify against https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-supported.html before customer-facing use.

templates.name: vertex
templates.description: Google Vertex AI — managed Gemini family + partner models on Google Cloud, with project-scoped IAM and regional hosts. Adapter is Vertex multi-model; admin must verify per-region availability against https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/models before customer-facing use.
